CancelPicker.Name: Cancel the HUD's target picker
CancelPicker.Hint: While the Argon HUD is waiting for a target ("0/1 Targets"), this key cancels the attack; while the Wild Shape or Starry Form picker is open, it closes the picker. Either way it does not open the game menu.

PENTARYN_TRANSFORM.NotTransformed: {name} is already in their normal form.
PENTARYN_TRANSFORM.AlreadyTransformed: {name} is already transformed. Return to normal form first.
PENTARYN_TRANSFORM.UnknownForm: That form isn't one of the known Wild Shape forms.
PENTARYN_TRANSFORM.SourceMissing: The form's actor is missing. The Wild Shape use was refunded.
PENTARYN_TRANSFORM.FormMode: {name} is set to dnd5e's "form" transform mode, which this module does not shape. Set its transform mode back to Challenge Rating. The use was refunded.
PENTARYN_TRANSFORM.ShiftFailed: {name} couldn't shift. The Wild Shape use was refunded; see the console.

Block.Cannot: You can't transform actors here. The GM needs to give you the Trusted role and turn on dnd5e's Allow Polymorphing.
Block.Incapacitated: {name} is incapacitated and can't Wild Shape.
Block.ZeroHP: {name} is at 0 HP and can't Wild Shape.
Block.NoToken: {name} needs a token on the scene you are viewing to Wild Shape.

Chat.ZeroHP: {name} drops to 0 HP and returns to normal form.
Chat.Incapacitated: {name} is incapacitated and returns to normal form.
Chat.LongRest: {name} returns to normal form to take a Long Rest.
Chat.StarryOn: {name} takes on a starry form — the {constellation}. Wild Shape {left}/{max} left, {duration}.
Chat.StarryIncapacitated: {name} is incapacitated; the starry form fades.

Effect.Name: Wild Shape: {form}
Effect.Ends: Return to {name} is a Bonus Action. The form ends at 0 HP, when Incapacitated, or after {duration}.
Effect.EndsNoTime: Return to {name} is a Bonus Action. The form ends at 0 HP or when Incapacitated.

Hud.TileHint: Click to shift. Right-click opens the beast's sheet.
Hud.WildShapeText: Bonus Action: become one of your known Beasts. You keep your HP and gain {temp} temp HP, keep your mind and class features, and can't cast spells. Ends early at 0 HP, when Incapacitated, or with Return (Bonus Action).
Hud.ChangeFormText: Using Wild Shape again ends this form and starts a new one, for one use (Bonus Action).
Hud.WildShapeHint: Click to pick a form. Right-click opens the feature.
Hud.HPTemp: {value} HP + {temp} temporary HP (they last until spent or a Long Rest)

Starry.Title: Starry Form
Starry.Text: Bonus Action: glow with a constellation instead of shape-shifting, for 10 minutes. Ends early if you dismiss it, are Incapacitated, or Wild Shape.
Starry.Hint: Click to pick a constellation. Right-click opens the feature.
Starry.HintActive: Click to end it or start a new form with another constellation (one more use).
Starry.HintActiveFree: Click to change constellation (Twinkling Constellations: free, at the start of your turn) or end it.
Starry.ArcherText: Now and as a Bonus Action on later turns: a luminous arrow at one creature within 60 ft — {toHit} to hit, {damage}.
Starry.ChaliceText: When you cast a spell with a slot that restores HP, you or a creature within 30 ft can regain {heal}.
Starry.DragonText: On Intelligence and Wisdom checks and Concentration saves, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
Starry.DragonFly: Fly Speed 20 ft, and you can hover.
Starry.EndText: Dismiss the starry form (no action required). The light goes out.
Starry.Ends: Ends after 10 minutes, if you are Incapacitated, if you dismiss it, or if you use Wild Shape.
Starry.BlockShifted: {name} is in a Beast form. Starry Form is taken instead of shape-shifting; return to normal form first.
